posts.title: 3-Hour Intro to Accelerated Resolution Therapy (ART) for PTSD and Trauma: Foundations, Emerging Research and Clinical Applications

summary_en: A free 3-hour live virtual workshop from PESI, presented by ART developer Laney Rosenzweig, lead trainer Amy Shuman and researcher Dr. Kevin Kip. It introduces Accelerated Resolution Therapy (ART): its foundational concepts, the neuroscience of emotional memory and memory reconsolidation, the proposed role of eye movements, and the clinical populations for which ART may be appropriate. ART reprocesses painful memories so the emotional charge fades without requiring detailed retellings. Held Monday 21 December 2026, 09:00-12:15 Central Time (23:00 Hong Kong/Macau time on 21 December to 02:15 on 22 December), fully online, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. Free replay access for 3 days; up to 3 CE hours available for a $49.99 upgrade. Aimed at counsellors, social workers, psychologists, marriage and family therapists and other mental health professionals.
summary_zh: PESI 免費 3 小時網上工作坊，由 ART 創始人 Laney Rosenzweig、首席培訓師 Amy Shuman 及研究學者 Kevin Kip 博士主講，介紹加速解決治療（ART）的基礎概念、情緒記憶的神經科學與記憶再鞏固研究、眼動在 ART 中的作用，以及適合使用 ART 的臨床群體。ART 透過治療師引導的眼動與自願影像替換，令創傷記憶的情緒負荷減輕，而無需詳細重述創傷。2026 年 12 月 21 日（星期一）美中時間 9:00–12:15 舉行（香港／澳門時間 12 月 21 日星期一晚上 11:00 至 12 月 22 日星期二凌晨 2:15），全程線上直播，費用全免，全程英語，須預先報名。3 日免費重溫；3 CE 學分另加 $49.99。對象為輔導員、社工、心理學家、婚姻及家庭治療師及其他心理健康專業人員。
